      @NotNull public MachineBehavior.Factory valve(@NotNull @NotNull List<String> storages, boolean exclusive)

    • modal

      @NotNull public MachineBehavior.Factory modal(@NotNull @NotNull List<String> insertInto, @NotNull @NotNull Map<String, List<String>> pushes)
      A valve or port with modes (a configurator cycles them): it fills the anchor's insertInto storages, and in each mode gives out the storages pushes lists for it (pushed to its neighbors, and taken by pipes). The block shows the mode (mode property, or active when not in input).
